lens: Skeptic. Fabrics compared at matched physical scale, using the 0.43 m seat width as the ruler: e4 at x0.81 against y_47306 at x1.0, q15 at x0.63 against y_47300 at x1.0, and q16 at x1.0 against y_47301. Measured: box mean, B/R, luminance p10/p50/p90, column CV, and fleck coverage (fraction of pixels above 1.4x the median) with fleck/ground L. Official photos decide colour; in-flight photos decide geometry (no new downloads). Candidate c6 (working tree on b88346e). Scratch files are in /tmp/claude-0/rater16A/ (st.py, q15cmp.png, fab_cmp.png, fleck.png, studio.png).

priorIssues.issue: w15a-1 petal fleck reads as white leopard spots
priorIssues.status: partly fixed close up; regressed at row distance
priorIssues.evidence: fleck.png. Close up (e4 pad at x0.81): the leopard halos are gone and the flecks are pale blue. Coverage 0.22 vs y_47306 0.13; fleck/ground L 2.62 vs 2.68; p90/p50 1.76-1.82 vs 1.59-1.68 (was 2.15); B/R 1.76-1.88 vs 2.04-2.30. The flecks now read as soft, dense stipple, where the photo has sparse, crisp petals on a darker ground (#2a345a vs #223165). At row distance (q15 seat 4 at x0.63 vs y_47300 seat 4) the fleck nearly disappears: coverage 0.08 vs 0.21, fleck/ground 1.76 vs 2.64, p90/p50 1.35 vs 1.91. The photo flecks (~2-3 px at ~3.3 mm/px, so ~7-10 mm petals) survive at that distance; the render's 0.18 m tile flecks do not. In q16 (near crown, x1.0) the flecks are #aab5d1 (B/R 1.23): whitish-grey against the photo's #7787b9 (B/R 1.55).

issues.title: Petal fleck: too fine and soft, so it vanishes at row distance; too dense and too grey-white close up
issues.evidence: fleck.png, q15cmp.png. q15 seat 4 at x0.63: coverage 0.08 vs y_47300 0.21, fleck/ground L 1.76 vs 2.64, p90/p50 1.35 vs 1.91. e4 pad at x0.81: coverage 0.22 vs y_47306 0.13; ground #2a345a vs #223165; B/R 1.76-1.88 vs 2.04-2.30. q16 crown flecks #aab5d1 (B/R 1.23) vs photo petals #7787b9 (B/R 1.55).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: keep the c6 'cores only' cut and pale-blue tint, but (a) make the petals ~1.5x larger (elongated ~7-10 mm x 3-4 mm, not ~4 mm dots), (b) halve their count (coverage ~0.13 close up), (c) keep them crisp, with no blur on the cores, (d) darken the ground ~10 % and push its B/R to ~2.2, (e) tint the flecks to ~#7f8fc4 (B/R ~1.55). Larger, sparser, crisp petals survive mip filtering, so the q15 coverage target is >= 0.18 with fleck/ground >= 2.3.

issues.title: Tick columns still wash out at row distance (colCV 0.05-0.07 vs 0.24)
issues.evidence: q15 seats 1/3 at x0.63: colCV 0.073/0.053, p10/p50 0.58. y_47300 seats 1/3: 0.241/0.236, 0.45/0.43. w15 was 0.086, so this got slightly worse. Close up the columns are fine.
issues.fix: As w15a-2: the dark inter-column channel has to survive minification. In the tick tile, widen and darken the dark channel between chain columns (~4-5 mm wide, ~-25 % L) so it holds at mip 2-3, or apply a mip bias of ~-0.5 to the tick layer. Target q15 colCV >= 0.15, p10/p50 <= 0.5.

issues.fix: 09a_econ.js / the econ fabric cycle: phase-shift the cycle so the q15 hero row reads tick / fleck / tick / fleck; mosaic and diamond stay elsewhere.

issues.title: Armrest is still an open post + strut bracket, not a closed J sweep
issues.fix: As w15a-4: one swept closed profile (~4 x 2.5 cm) along a J from the rear pan rail forward and up to the pad front, with no strut. Light grey #cfd2d6.

issues.title: Headrest cover head-on is too light and too grey in the hero view
issues.evidence: q15 four covers: L55/70/70/56, B/R 1.62/1.50/1.50/1.62. y_47300 matching covers: L62/47/37/35, B/R 1.61/1.82/2.01/1.99. The photo cover is a deep navy leatherette; the render reads slate grey. In y_47306 / y_47301, lit covers read silver-grey at oblique angles, so the fix should be in the hue and the base value, with the sheen coming from specular.
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover: base colour ~#2a3150 (B/R ~1.9, ~25 % darker than now) and roughness ~0.45, so the grazing views still pick up a silver sheen. Recheck: q15 cover L ~45, B/R >= 1.8.

issues.title: Odd tick-pattern patch on the crown of a fleck back from above (q16 near seat)
issues.evidence: fleck.png top right: a darker tick rectangle (~8 x 2 cm) sits on the fleck crown behind the cover of the q16 near seat. It is the centre strip ending on top of the crown.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: end the dark tick centre strip below the crown roll, or use the back's own weave for the strip on non-tick backs.

issues.title: Screen black border too thick; glass slightly too tall for 16:9
issues.evidence: q18: glass/bezel width 0.85 vs y_47305 0.93; glass aspect ~1.63 vs ~1.78. No LED / sensor dots on the lower bezel (y_47305 shows 4-5).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: thin the side and top border to ~3 % of the bezel width (keep a ~6 % bottom border), set the glass to 16:9, and add 4-5 small dots on the lower border.
